eventMetadata.context_description: The closely bunched top probabilities for the Oklahoma City Thunder and San Antonio Spurs reflect trader consensus on their young, deep rosters returning intact after strong 2025-26 regular seasons and Western Conference Finals appearances. Victor Wembanyama’s continued development anchors San Antonio’s positioning, while Oklahoma City’s core featuring Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and supporting talent provides comparable continuity and depth. The Boston Celtics and New York Knicks trail as established Eastern Conference contenders, with the reigning champion Knicks facing projected regression in a loaded field. Lower-tier teams trail due to age profiles or slower roster building, maintaining a competitive dynamic driven by recent playoff outcomes and offseason stability rather than any single roster overhaul.
